subject.title: Clarify status of optional bird transport

question: Should Birdclaw publicly document `xurl` as the new-user live transport while treating `bird` as private or existing-install-only, or will `bird` receive a restored public distribution path?
rationale: Current source actively supports and sometimes prefers `bird`, while the public npm package is deprecated and the documented repository is unavailable; repository evidence cannot determine the owner's intended distribution policy.

options.title: Document xurl public default
options.body: Keep working `bird` code paths, but make `xurl` the public new-user path and label `bird` private or existing-install-only until distribution returns.

options.title: Restore public bird distribution
options.body: Publish an authoritative supported package or repository and continue documenting `bird` as a public optional transport.

options.title: Retire bird paths
options.body: Plan replacement or removal of `bird`-only capabilities before deleting its public guidance.

recommendation.title: Document xurl public default
recommendation.body: Keep working `bird` code paths, but make `xurl` the public new-user path and label `bird` private or existing-install-only until distribution returns.

likelyOwner.reason: The external package status and Birdclaw transport policy are predominantly authored and controlled by steipete.
